Subject: MAP sync: procurement gating + MSA redlines

Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed, procurement and legal want a short weekly sync to track the MAP milestones: final MSA redlines, order form, and vendor setup (PO, tax forms, vendor portal).

High level ask for this week:
- Confirm whether Redwood can accept Novus standard data residency language (we highlighted a couple of lines in the sample MSA).
- Provide an ETA for legal redlines and updated order form with bill-to.
- Outline vendor setup steps you require from procurement so we can kick off vendor registration.

Can we do a 30-min sync Thursday? Attaching the procurement checklist we use for enterprise vendors.

Attachments: Novus_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (attachment stub)

Elena Park
Sr. Procurement Manager | Novus Health
elena.park@novushealth.com
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP sync: procurement gating + MSA redlines

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Thursday 11:00am PT works for a 30-min touch. Calendar invite sent.

Quick status from our side (summary for the sync):
- MSA redlines: Redwood legal has reviewed Novus' edits. Laura is preparing a consolidated redline (we expect v3) with comments on data residency and audit log scope.
- Order form: Draft with pricing and billing contacts is in progress; Marissa will share the first-pass PDF before the meeting.
- Vendor setup: Our vendor onboarding requires a signed MSA + completed W-9 (or equivalent) and PO. We can accept Novus' PO; procurement onboarding typically completes within 5 business days after vendor profile is filled.

Action items before Thursday (owners):
1) Laura to circulate MSA redline v3 and call out any non-negotiable clauses by EOD Wednesday. (owner: laura_bennett)
2) Marissa to attach draft order form with list prices and billing fields for Novus review. (owner: marissa_cole)
3) Karthik to confirm internal vendor setup checklist and provide the exact vendor contact fields Novus needs to fill. (owner: karthik_iyer)

Attachments referenced: Redlines_Novus_Redwood_MSA_v3.docx (will be shared), OrderForm_Draft.pdf (coming from Marissa)

Thanks — see you Thursday.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, North America | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com

Date: 2026-04-13T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP sync: procurement gating + MSA redlines

Karthik / Elena —

I've attached a consolidated redline (Redlines_Novus_Redwood_MSA_v3.docx). Key notes:
- Data residency: Novus' proposed language is mostly acceptable, but we need to clarify the scope for backups and disaster recovery. I flagged a narrow exception for cross-region replication that requires contractual safeguards; propose the following compromise language (see pg. 4).
- Audit logs: Redwood can provide audit logs for admin-level activity; we'll include a delivery cadence and sample schema in an appendix.
- Indemnity / liability caps: Laura will mark the sections that are typically negotiable vs. what requires senior sign-off.

Open question for Novus legal: do you need an explicit SOC 2 artifact handover clause or is a certificate upload sufficient for your vendor gating?

Action: Elena, if you can confirm the acceptable data residency wording (yes/no) by EOD Wednesday we can finalize and send back for procurement to prepare the PO.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Ben Holt <ben.holt@novushealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-04-14T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP sync: procurement gating + MSA redlines

Laura / Karthik —

Thanks for the redline and the clear asks. A few operational points from procurement:
- PO timeline: We can issue the PO as soon as a signed MSA and final order form are back to us. Target is within 3 business days of receiving the signed docs.
- Vendor profile: Our system needs tax ID, W-9 (US), and primary billing contact.
- SOC 2: the certificate upload is fine for the gating step; we only require the SOC 2 report if exceptions are requested.

I've attached our PO template (Novus_PO_Template.xlsx). We'll aim to have the PO out the week after you return the signed MSA.

Ben Holt
Director, Vendor Ops | Novus Health
ben.holt@novushealth.com
